campaign.author: Fantasoft LLC
campaign.description: Several clans of giants are threatening to wipe out a human city.  Do what you can to save them and to destroy the menacing giant hordes.
campaign.name: Assault on Giant Mountain

restrictions.description: Assault on Giant Mountain has no restrictions.  However, we suggest you do not pluck your own eyes out.  More of a guidline than a rule really.
